decisions.choice: in the land of Egypt: the one body of law given before Sinai
decisions.reason: Almost all of Israel's laws are given at Mount Sinai or on the way to the promised land. The Passover laws are set apart as given in Egypt itself, on the eve of the departure, so that the feast is tied to the event it remembers.

decisions.choice: to Moses and to Aaron: God speaks to both, who pass the word to the people
decisions.reason: The instructions are addressed to both brothers (as in 6:13 and 7:8), and Moses passes them on to the elders in verse 21.

decisions.choice: While ... were still in Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable spells out why the place is named: the law came before they left Egypt.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit", "frappa"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit", "a frappé"); God's and Moses' instructions in the future at Literal and Balanced ("vous mangerez"), with "vous devez", "il faut" or the imperative at Readable
alternatives: passé composé for the narrative at every level
decisions.reason: As the French style guide and the Pentateuch terms set: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, the passé composé that of the plain Readable level. Most of the chapter is law given as speech, which French gives in the future, the usual form of a binding instruction.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text carries no deity_pronoun spans in this chapter.

records.literal_gloss: This month [will be] for you [the] head of months; first it [will be] for you of [the] months of the year.

en.L: "This month [shall be] for you the head of months; it [shall be] the first of the months of the year for you.
en.B: "From now on this month is to head your calendar: count it as the first month of your year.
en.R: "This month will now begin your calendar. It will be the first month of the year for you.

decisions.choice: the head of months: the month that begins the year
decisions.reason: "Head" means the first in order, as the second half of the verse explains. Israel's year of festivals is to be counted from the month of the exodus.

decisions.choice: this month: the spring month Abib, later called Nisan
decisions.reason: The month is named Abib, "fresh ears of grain", in 13:4, 23:15 and 34:18, and later Nisan (Nehemiah 2:1; Esther 3:7). It falls in March to April. Exodus also speaks of the harvest feast "at the going out of the year" (23:16), a reckoning of the year from the autumn, so this verse fixes the order of the sacred year without ruling out the other.

decisions.choice: for you: plural, all Israel
decisions.reason: "You" is plural here and through the instructions that follow. God speaks to Moses and Aaron, but the commands are for the whole people and their households.

decisions.choice: From now on / now
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "now" to show that this is a new reckoning of the year, which the Hebrew implies by setting it at this moment.

decisions.choice: God's laws in 해라체: commands as -하라 / -하지 말라 at Literal and Balanced, -해야 한다 / -하면 안 된다 at Readable; a rule about "they" or "anyone" in the plain written style (-한다, -해야 한다)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch term sheet sets for the laws. The older endings (-할지니라) are out of place in a modern translation; "-하라" is the current written imperative, and Readable says the same thing in plain sentences. This holds for the laws in these chapters.

decisions.choice: God's instructions for Israel use "các ngươi" at every level, with "phải" and "không được" (L, B) and "phải", "đừng" in short sentences (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form for laws and instructions: God addresses Israel through Moses and Aaron as a lawgiver, so the warmer "các con" used to Moses himself (9:1; 11:1) gives way to "các ngươi" here, as at Literal.

decisions.choice: vocês
decisions.reason: The "you" of these instructions is plural (m3): God speaks to Moses and Aaron, and through them to every household of Israel, so Portuguese says "vocês" through verse 20, and Literal and Balanced give the rules in the future ("comerão", "guardarão"), Readable with "têm de" and the imperative.

decisions.choice: "तुम्हारे" (familiar plural you) when God speaks to Moses, Aaron and Israel
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note settles, God speaking to people says तुम, to one person or many; here the "you" is plural, all Israel.

decisions.choice: "для вас", "у вас", "ваш" (plural)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "for you" is plural (m3): the calendar is for all Israel, so Russian uses the plural вы, as the note on forms of address asks.

source.text: דַּבְּר֗וּ אֶֽל־כָּל־עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֶּעָשֹׂ֖ר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְיִקְח֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם אִ֛ישׁ שֶׂ֥ה לְבֵית־אָבֹ֖ת שֶׂ֥ה לַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: Speak to all [the] congregation of Israel, saying, on [the] tenth of this month, and they will take for themselves each man a lamb for [a] house of fathers, a lamb for the house.

en.B: Speak to the whole community of Israel and tell them: 'On the tenth day of this month the head of every family is to pick out a lamb, one lamb to a household.
en.R: Tell the whole community of Israel this: 'On the tenth day of this month, the man who leads each family must choose a lamb. Each household needs one lamb.

fr.L: Parlez à toute la communauté d’Israël, en disant : “Le dix de ce mois, ils prendront pour eux, chacun, un agneau par maison de pères, un agneau par maison.

sw.L: Semeni na jumuiya yote ya Israeli, mkisema, 'Siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu watajitwalia kila mwanamume mwanakondoo kwa ajili ya nyumba ya baba, mwanakondoo kwa ajili ya nyumba.

ko.L: 이스라엘 온 회중에게 말하여라. '이 달 열흘에 그들은 저마다 조상의 집에 따라 어린양 한 마리씩, 한 집에 어린양 한 마리씩 자기들을 위하여 잡아 두어야 한다.

ko.R: 이스라엘 온 회중에게 이렇게 말하여라. '이 달 열흘날에 집집마다 가장이 양을 한 마리씩 골라야 한다. 한 집에 한 마리가 필요하다.

vi.L: Hãy nói với toàn thể hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên rằng: 'Vào ngày mồng mười tháng này, mỗi người phải bắt cho mình một con chiên con theo nhà cha, mỗi nhà một con chiên con.

pt.R: Digam a toda a comunidade de Israel: 'No dia dez deste mês, o homem que lidera cada família tem de escolher um cordeiro. Cada casa precisa de um cordeiro.

am.L: ለእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ተናገሩ፦ “በዚህ ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን እያንዳንዱ ሰው ለየአባቱ ቤት አንድ ጠቦት፣ ለቤተሰቡ አንድ ጠቦት ለራሱ ይውሰድ።
am.B: ለእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሯቸው፦ “በዚህ ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን የየቤተሰቡ ራስ አንድ ጠቦት ይምረጥ፤ ለአንድ ቤተሰብ አንድ ጠቦት ይሁን።
am.R: ለእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ይህን ንገሯቸው፦ “በዚህ ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን እያንዳንዱን ቤተሰብ የሚመራው ሰው አንድ ጠቦት መምረጥ አለበት። ለእያንዳንዱ ቤተሰብ አንድ ጠቦት ያስፈልጋል።

hi.L: इस्राएल की सारी मंडली से यह कहो, 'इस महीने के दसवें [दिन] वे अपने लिए, हर पुरुष, पितृकुल के अनुसार एक मेम्ना लें, हर घराने के लिए एक मेम्ना।
hi.B: इस्राएल की पूरी मंडली से कहो: 'इस महीने के दसवें दिन हर परिवार का मुखिया एक मेम्ना चुने, हर घराने के लिए एक मेम्ना।
hi.R: इस्राएल की पूरी मंडली को यह बताओ: 'इस महीने के दसवें दिन हर परिवार के मुखिया को एक मेम्ना चुनना होगा। हर घर के लिए एक मेम्ना चाहिए।

ru.L: Скажите всей общине Израиля, говоря: “В десятый [день] этого месяца пусть возьмут себе каждый ягнёнка на отцовский дом, ягнёнка на дом.
ru.B: Скажите всей общине Израиля: “В десятый день этого месяца глава каждой семьи пусть выберет ягнёнка, по одному ягнёнку на дом.
ru.R: Скажите всей общине Израиля вот что: “В десятый день этого месяца мужчина, который возглавляет семью, должен выбрать ягнёнка. Каждой семье нужен один ягнёнок.

uk.L: Скажіть усій громаді Ізраїля, кажучи: “Десятого [дня] цього місяця нехай візьмуть собі кожен чоловік ягня на батьківський дім, ягня на дім.
uk.B: Скажіть усій громаді Ізраїля: “Десятого дня цього місяця глава кожної родини має вибрати ягня, одне ягня на родину.
uk.R: Скажіть усій громаді Ізраїля: “Десятого дня цього місяця чоловік, що очолює родину, має вибрати ягня. Для кожної родини потрібне одне ягня.

decisions.choice: congregation: Israel as one gathered community
decisions.reason: This is the first time the word is used for Israel. It means a body of people who meet and act together, and it becomes a regular name for Israel in the wilderness (16:1-2; Numbers 1:2). The whole people, household by household, is to keep the Passover.

decisions.choice: lamb: one young animal from the flock, a sheep or a goat
decisions.reason: The word means a single animal of the flock and covers both sheep and goats, as verse 5 says.

decisions.choice: each man ... a father's house: the head of each household
decisions.reason: A "father's house" is a family under its male head, often with grown sons and their families. The man is the head of his household, who acts for all who live in it.

decisions.choice: community
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "community", the everyday word, as in 12:47; Literal keeps "congregation".

decisions.choice: the head of every family / the man who leads each family
decisions.reason: "Each man" here is the man at the head of each household (m3), so Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "mwanakondoo" for the animal (seh) through the chapter, with "mwanambuzi" beside it where verse 5 names the goats
alternatives: "mnyama wa kundi" (an animal of the flock)
decisions.reason: Seh is one animal of the flock, sheep or goat (m2). Swahili has no single everyday word for both, so it uses the word for the usual Passover animal, as the English "lamb" does, and verse 5 makes the goat explicit.

decisions.choice: "어린양" for seh, at Literal and Balanced; Readable explains in 12:5 that it may be a young sheep or goat
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers a young animal of the flock, sheep or goat (meaning decision); "어린양" is the Korean word that links this meal with the Passover lamb of 1 Corinthians 5:7 and John 1:29, and 12:5 says plainly that a goat may be chosen.

decisions.choice: "회중" for the congregation ('edah); "조상의 집" (L) and "집안" (B, R) for the father's house
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch term sheet sets; "회중" names Israel gathered as one community.

decisions.choice: "hội chúng" for the congregation; "nhà cha" (L), "gia đình" (B, R) for the father's house
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words: "hội chúng" for Israel gathered as one people, and "nhà cha" kept at Literal for the family under one father.

decisions.choice: "chiên con" for the young animal of the flock
decisions.reason: The word covers a lamb or a young goat (meaning decision); "chiên con" is the familiar name of the Passover animal, and verse 5 says that a goat may be taken.

decisions.choice: a comunidade
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it: Israel as one gathered body (m1) is "a comunidade" at every level; "congregação" sounds like a church or a religious order. "A assembleia" is kept for the related word in verse 6.

decisions.choice: "ማኅበር" for the congregation; "ጠቦት" for the lamb
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch term for the congregation. "ጠቦት" is a young animal of the flock, lamb or kid, as the meaning decision reads the word (verse 5).

decisions.choice: "የአባት ቤት" (Literal); "ቤተሰብ" (household, Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch term for the father's house.

decisions.choice: "मंडली" for the congregation (ʿedah) at every level
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch's term for Israel as one gathered community; सभा is kept for the assembly (qahal), so the two Hebrew words stay apart.

decisions.choice: "पितृकुल" (L); "परिवार" (B, R) for the father's house
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's forms: Literal keeps the Hebrew "father's house", Balanced and Readable use the everyday word for the household it means.

decisions.choice: "община" for the congregation (ʿedah)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles "община" for ʿedah at every level and keeps "собрание" for qahal (12:6). It is an everyday word, so Readable keeps it too, where the English Readable says "community".

decisions.choice: "ягнёнок"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means a young animal of the flock, sheep or goat (m2, and 12:5). "Ягнёнок" is the plain modern word; the church word "агнец" is not used. Verse 5 says that a kid may be chosen too.

decisions.choice: "громада" for the congregation
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the Hebrew congregation, used through the Pentateuch; "зібрання" is kept for the assembly (verse 6).

decisions.choice: "ягня"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means one young animal of the flock, sheep or goat (m2); "ягня" is the everyday word, and verse 5 says it may be a goat.

source.text: וְאִם־יִמְעַ֣ט הַבַּיִת֮ מִהְיֹ֣ת מִשֶּׂה֒ וְלָקַ֣ח ה֗וּא וּשְׁכֵנ֛וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֶל־בֵּית֖וֹ בְּמִכְסַ֣ת נְפָשֹׁ֑ת אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י אָכְל֔וֹ תָּכֹ֖סּוּ עַל־הַשֶּֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if is too small the household for being for a lamb, then will take he and his neighbor the near to his house, by [the] number of persons; each man according to [the] mouth of his eating you will count for the lamb.

en.L: And if the household is too small for a lamb, then he and his neighbor near to his house shall take [one], according to the number of persons; according to what each one eats you shall make your count for the lamb.
en.B: Should a household be too small for a whole lamb, the man is to join with the neighbor who lives closest and take one between them, counting the people in both homes. Divide the lamb by how much each one will eat.
en.R: Some households may be too small to eat a whole lamb. Then they should share one with their closest neighbors. Count the people and think about how much each one can eat, so you will know how many can share a lamb.

es.L: Y si la casa es demasiado pequeña para un cordero, entonces él y su vecino, el cercano a su casa, [lo] tomarán según el número de personas; según lo que cada uno coma {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} la cuenta para el cordero.
es.B: Si una familia es demasiado pequeña para un cordero entero, el hombre se juntará con el vecino más cercano y tomarán uno entre los dos, contando a las personas de ambas casas. {{plural_you:Repartirán|Repartiréis}} el cordero según lo que cada uno vaya a comer.
es.R: Puede que algunas familias sean demasiado pequeñas para comerse un cordero entero. Entonces deben compartirlo con sus vecinos más cercanos. {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} a las personas y {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} cuánto puede comer cada una; así {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} cuántos pueden compartir un cordero.

fr.L: Et si la maison est trop petite pour un agneau, alors lui et son voisin, le proche de sa maison, [en] prendront [un] selon le nombre des personnes ; chacun selon ce qu’il mange, vous ferez le compte pour l’agneau.
fr.B: Si une famille est trop petite pour un agneau entier, l’homme s’associera à son plus proche voisin, et ils en prendront un ensemble, en comptant les personnes des deux maisons. Vous répartirez l’agneau selon ce que chacun mangera.
fr.R: Certaines familles seront peut-être trop petites pour manger un agneau entier. Elles devront alors le partager avec leurs voisins les plus proches. Comptez les personnes et pensez à ce que chacun peut manger : vous saurez ainsi combien de personnes peuvent partager un agneau.

sw.L: Na ikiwa nyumba ni ndogo mno kwa mwanakondoo, basi yeye na jirani yake aliye karibu na nyumba yake watatwaa [mmoja] kwa kadiri ya hesabu ya watu; kila mtu kwa kadiri ya ulaji wake mtafanya hesabu kwa ajili ya mwanakondoo.
sw.B: Ikiwa jamaa ni ndogo mno kwa mwanakondoo mzima, mwanamume huyo ashirikiane na jirani aliye karibu naye zaidi, nao wachukue mmoja kwa pamoja, wakihesabu watu wa nyumba zote mbili. Mgawanye mwanakondoo kwa kadiri ya kiasi ambacho kila mtu atakula.
sw.R: Huenda jamaa nyingine zikawa ndogo mno kula mwanakondoo mzima. Basi zishirikiane na majirani zao walio karibu zaidi. Hesabuni watu, mfikirie kila mmoja anaweza kula kiasi gani, ili mjue ni watu wangapi wanaweza kushiriki mwanakondoo mmoja.

ko.L: 만일 그 식구가 어린양 한 마리에 비해 너무 적으면, 그는 자기 집에 가까운 이웃과 함께 사람 수에 따라 [한 마리를] 잡아야 한다. 저마다 먹는 양에 따라 너희는 어린양을 셈하여라.
ko.B: 식구가 너무 적어서 어린양 한 마리를 다 먹을 수 없으면, 가장은 가장 가까이 사는 이웃과 함께 두 집의 사람 수를 세어 한 마리를 잡아라. 각 사람이 먹을 만큼을 헤아려 어린양을 나누어라.
ko.R: 어떤 집은 식구가 너무 적어서 양 한 마리를 다 먹지 못할 수도 있다. 그러면 가장 가까운 이웃과 함께 한 마리를 나누어야 한다. 사람 수를 세고 각 사람이 얼마나 먹을 수 있는지 헤아려서, 몇 사람이 한 마리를 나눌지 정해야 한다.

vi.L: Nếu nhà quá ít người cho một con chiên con, thì người ấy và người láng giềng gần nhà mình sẽ bắt [một con] theo số người; các ngươi phải tính cho con chiên con theo sức ăn của mỗi người.
vi.B: Nếu một nhà có quá ít người để ăn hết một con chiên con, thì người chủ nhà phải cùng với người láng giềng gần nhất bắt chung một con, tùy theo số người của hai nhà. Hãy tính phần chiên con theo sức ăn của mỗi người.
vi.R: Có những nhà quá ít người, không ăn hết một con chiên con. Khi đó họ phải ăn chung với người láng giềng gần nhất. Hãy đếm số người và xem mỗi người ăn được bao nhiêu, để biết bao nhiêu người có thể ăn chung một con.

pt.L: E, se a casa for pequena demais para um cordeiro, então ele e o seu vizinho mais próximo da sua casa tomarão [um], conforme o número de pessoas; conforme o que cada um come, vocês farão a conta para o cordeiro.
pt.B: Se uma família for pequena demais para um cordeiro inteiro, o homem deve se juntar com o vizinho que mora mais perto e tomar um cordeiro para os dois, contando as pessoas das duas casas. Dividam o cordeiro conforme o quanto cada um vai comer.
pt.R: Algumas famílias podem ser pequenas demais para comer um cordeiro inteiro. Então devem dividir um com os vizinhos mais próximos. Contem as pessoas e pensem em quanto cada uma consegue comer. Assim vocês vão saber quantas pessoas podem dividir um cordeiro.

am.L: ቤተሰቡም ለጠቦት ቢያንስ፣ እርሱና ለቤቱ ቅርብ የሆነው ጎረቤቱ እንደ ሰዎቹ ቁጥር [አንድ] ይውሰዱ፤ እያንዳንዱ እንደሚበላው መጠን ለጠቦቱ ቁጠሩ።
am.B: አንድ ቤተሰብ አንድ ሙሉ ጠቦት ለመብላት በጣም ትንሽ ቢሆን፣ ሰውየው በአቅራቢያው ካለው ጎረቤቱ ጋር ተባብሮ የሁለቱን ቤት ሰዎች ቁጥር በማስላት አንድ ጠቦት ይውሰዱ። ጠቦቱንም እያንዳንዱ በሚበላው መጠን አከፋፍሉ።
am.R: አንዳንድ ቤተሰቦች አንድ ሙሉ ጠቦት ለመብላት ትንሽ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ። እንዲህ ከሆነ አቅራቢያቸው ካሉት ጎረቤቶቻቸው ጋር አንድ ጠቦት ይካፈሉ። ስንት ሰዎች አንድ ጠቦት መካፈል እንደሚችሉ ለማወቅ ሰዎቹን ቁጠሩ፤ እያንዳንዱም ምን ያህል እንደሚበላ አስቡ።

hi.L: और यदि घराना मेम्ने के लिए बहुत छोटा हो, तो वह और उसका पड़ोसी जो उसके घर के निकट [रहता] है, प्राणियों की गिनती के अनुसार [एक] लें; हर एक के खाने के अनुसार तुम मेम्ने के लिए गिनती करना।
hi.B: यदि किसी घराने के लोग पूरे मेम्ने के लिए बहुत कम हों, तो वह अपने सबसे निकट रहनेवाले पड़ोसी के साथ मिलकर एक मेम्ना ले, और दोनों घरों के लोगों को गिने। हर एक जितना खाएगा, उसी के अनुसार मेम्ने का हिसाब करना।
hi.R: अगर किसी घर में इतने कम लोग हों कि वे पूरा मेम्ना न खा सकें, तो उन्हें अपने सबसे पास के पड़ोसियों के साथ मिलकर एक मेम्ना बाँटना होगा। लोगों को गिनना और सोचना कि हर कोई कितना खा सकता है, ताकि तुम जान सको कि एक मेम्ने में कितने लोग शामिल हो सकते हैं।

ru.L: Если же дом будет слишком мал для ягнёнка, то пусть возьмёт он и сосед его, близкий к его дому, по числу душ; каждого по тому, сколько он ест, считайте на ягнёнка.
ru.B: Если семья слишком мала для целого ягнёнка, пусть хозяин возьмёт его вместе с ближайшим соседом, посчитав людей в обоих домах. Делите ягнёнка по тому, сколько каждый съест.
ru.R: Некоторые семьи могут оказаться слишком маленькими, чтобы съесть целого ягнёнка. Тогда пусть они разделят его с ближайшими соседями. Посчитайте людей и подумайте, сколько каждый может съесть, — так вы узнаете, сколько человек может разделить одного ягнёнка.

uk.L: А якщо дім замалий для ягняти, то нехай візьмуть він і його сусід, близький до його дому, за числом душ; кожен за тим, скільки їсть, ви рахуватимете на ягня.
uk.B: Якщо ж родина замала для цілого ягняти, нехай глава родини обʼєднається з найближчим сусідом і візьмуть одне на двох, полічивши людей в обох домах. Розподіліть ягня за тим, скільки кожен зʼїсть.
uk.R: Деякі родини можуть бути замалі, щоб зʼїсти ціле ягня. Тоді вони мають поділитися ним із найближчими сусідами. Порахуйте людей і подумайте, скільки кожен може зʼїсти, щоб знати, скільки людей може розділити одне ягня.

decisions.choice: each one according to his eating: by how much each person eats
decisions.reason: The phrase reads "each according to the mouth of his eating". The people sharing a lamb are to be counted so that it is eaten up and nothing is left over (verse 10).

decisions.choice: his neighbor near to his house: the household next door
decisions.reason: A small household joins with the closest one, so that two families share one animal and one meal.

decisions.choice: so you will know how many can share a lamb
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the purpose of the counting, which the Hebrew implies.

source.text: שֶׂ֥ה תָמִ֛ים זָכָ֥ר בֶּן־שָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם מִן־הַכְּבָשִׂ֥ים וּמִן־הָעִזִּ֖ים תִּקָּֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A lamb unblemished, male, son of a year it will be for you; from the sheep and from the goats you will take [it].

en.L: [Your] lamb shall be without blemish, a male, a son of a year; from the sheep or from the goats you shall take [it].
en.B: It must be a sound, unblemished male in its first year, picked from either the sheep or the goats.
en.R: The animal must be a healthy one-year-old male with nothing wrong with it. It can be a young sheep or a young goat.

es.L: El cordero será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sin defecto, macho, hijo de un año; lo {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} de las ovejas o de las cabras.
es.B: Ha de ser un macho de un año, sano y sin defecto, escogido de entre las ovejas o de entre las cabras.
es.R: El animal tiene que ser un macho de un año, sano y sin ningún defecto. Puede ser un corderito o un cabrito.

fr.L: L’agneau sera pour vous sans défaut, un mâle, fils d’un an ; vous [le] prendrez parmi les moutons ou parmi les chèvres.
fr.B: Ce sera un mâle d’un an, sain et sans défaut, que vous choisirez parmi les moutons ou parmi les chèvres.
fr.R: L’animal doit être un mâle d’un an, en bonne santé et sans aucun défaut. Ce peut être un agneau ou un chevreau.

sw.L: Mwanakondoo atakuwa kwenu asiye na kasoro, wa kiume, mwana wa mwaka mmoja; mtamtwaa katika kondoo au katika mbuzi.
sw.B: Awe dume wa mwaka mmoja, mzima, asiye na kasoro, aliyechaguliwa katika kondoo au katika mbuzi.
sw.R: Mnyama huyo lazima awe dume wa mwaka mmoja, mwenye afya, asiye na dosari yoyote. Anaweza kuwa mwanakondoo au mwanambuzi.

ko.L: [너희의] 어린양은 흠 없는 일 년 된 수컷이어야 한다. 너희는 양들 가운데서나 염소들 가운데서 [그것을] 잡아라.
ko.B: 그것은 흠 없는 일 년 된 수컷이어야 한다. 양이나 염소 가운데서 골라라.
ko.R: 그 짐승은 아무 흠이 없는 한 살 된 건강한 수컷이어야 한다. 새끼 양이어도 되고 새끼 염소여도 된다.

vi.L: Con chiên con [của các ngươi] phải không tì vết, con đực, một tuổi; các ngươi phải bắt [nó] trong bầy chiên hoặc trong bầy dê.
vi.B: Đó phải là một con đực một tuổi, lành lặn, không tì vết, chọn trong bầy chiên hoặc trong bầy dê.
vi.R: Con vật phải là một con đực một tuổi, khỏe mạnh, không có tật gì. Đó có thể là một con chiên non hay một con dê non.

pt.L: O cordeiro será para vocês sem defeito, macho, filho de um ano; das ovelhas ou das cabras vocês [o] tomarão.
pt.B: Deve ser um macho de um ano, saudável e sem defeito, escolhido entre as ovelhas ou entre as cabras.
pt.R: O animal tem de ser um macho de um ano, saudável e sem nenhum defeito. Pode ser um carneirinho ou um cabrito.

am.L: ጠቦታችሁ ነውር የሌለበት፣ ተባዕት፣ የአንድ ዓመት ልጅ ይሁን፤ ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ውሰዱት።
am.B: ጤነኛና ነውር የሌለበት የአንድ ዓመት ተባዕት ይሁን፤ ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ልትመርጡት ትችላላችሁ።
am.R: እንስሳው ምንም ጉድለት የሌለበት ጤነኛ የአንድ ዓመት ተባዕት መሆን አለበት። የበግ ጠቦት ወይም የፍየል ግልገል ሊሆን ይችላል።

hi.L: [तुम्हारा] मेम्ना निर्दोष, नर, एक वर्ष का हो; तुम [उसे] भेड़ों में से या बकरियों में से लेना।
hi.B: वह स्वस्थ और निर्दोष नर हो, जो अपने पहले वर्ष में हो, और उसे भेड़ों या बकरियों में से चुनना।
hi.R: वह जानवर एक साल का स्वस्थ नर होना चाहिए, जिसमें कोई दोष न हो। वह भेड़ का बच्चा भी हो सकता है और बकरी का बच्चा भी।

ru.L: Ягнёнок без изъяна, мужского пола, однолетний пусть будет у вас; из овец или из коз возьмите [его].
ru.B: Это должен быть здоровый самец без изъяна, на первом году жизни, взятый из овец или из коз.
ru.R: Животное должно быть здоровым годовалым самцом, у которого нет никакого недостатка. Это может быть ягнёнок или козлёнок.

uk.L: Ягня [ваше] буде без вади, самець, однолітній; з овець чи з кіз візьмете [його].
uk.B: Це має бути здоровий самець без вади, однолітній, з овець або з кіз.
uk.R: Тварина має бути здоровим однолітнім самцем без жодної вади. Це може бути ягня або козеня.

decisions.choice: lamb: a young sheep or a young goat
decisions.reason: The animal of verse 3 may be taken from the sheep or from the goats; a young goat is just as fitting as a young sheep.

decisions.choice: unblemished: whole, with no defect
decisions.reason: The word means complete and sound. Animals offered to God had to be free of injury and disease (Leviticus 22:19-22).

decisions.choice: son of a year: a year old, in its first year
decisions.reason: "Son of a year" is the Hebrew way of giving an age. It describes an animal in its first year (Leviticus 23:12).

decisions.choice: sound, unblemished
decisions.reason: Balanced uses two words to show that the animal must be both healthy and free of any mark or injury.

decisions.choice: "흠 없는" for tamim, at every level
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch term sheet sets for "without defect"; Readable adds "건강한" as the English Readable adds "healthy".

decisions.choice: "không tì vết" for "without blemish"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's phrase for an animal with no defect, used through the laws of offering.

decisions.choice: "ነውር የሌለበት" for "without blemish"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch term, first used here in Exodus.

decisions.choice: "निर्दोष" for without defect
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch's term for an animal fit to be offered, whole and with no defect; Readable says it in plain words.

decisions.choice: "без изъяна"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles "без изъяна" for "without defect": the animal is whole, with no flaw or injury. "Без порока" now suggests moral fault.

decisions.choice: "без вади"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for the animal "without defect", used through the cultic laws.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְמִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת עַ֣ד אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְשָׁחֲט֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ כֹּ֛ל קְהַ֥ל עֲדַֽת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be for you for keeping until [the] fourteenth day of this month, and will slaughter it all [the] assembly of [the] congregation of Israel between the two evenings.

en.L: And it shall be kept by you until the fourteenth day of this month, and all the assembly of the congregation of Israel shall slaughter it between the two evenings.
en.B: Look after it until the fourteenth day of this month. On that day, as evening falls, the whole assembled community of Israel is to slaughter their lambs.
en.R: Take care of the animal until the fourteenth day of the month. Then, as the sun goes down that evening, all the people of Israel must kill their animals.

es.L: Y lo {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} en custodia hasta el día catorce de este mes, y toda la asamblea de la comunidad de Israel lo degollará entre las dos tardes.
es.B: {{plural_you:Guárdenlo|Guardadlo}} hasta el día catorce de este mes. Ese día, al caer la tarde, toda la comunidad de Israel reunida degollará sus corderos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cuiden|Cuidad}} al animal hasta el día catorce del mes. Entonces, cuando se ponga el sol esa tarde, todo el pueblo de Israel debe matar sus animales.

fr.L: Et il sera gardé par vous jusqu’au quatorzième jour de ce mois, et toute l’assemblée de la communauté d’Israël l’égorgera entre les deux soirs.
fr.B: Vous le garderez jusqu’au quatorzième jour de ce mois. Ce jour-là, à la tombée du soir, toute la communauté d’Israël rassemblée égorgera ses agneaux.
fr.R: Prenez soin de l’animal jusqu’au quatorzième jour du mois. Puis, ce soir-là, au coucher du soleil, tout le peuple d’Israël doit tuer les animaux.

sw.L: Naye atakuwa kwenu kwa kulindwa hadi siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi huu, na kusanyiko lote la jumuiya ya Israeli watamchinja kati ya jioni mbili.
sw.B: Mtamtunza hadi siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi huu. Siku hiyo, jioni inapoingia, jumuiya yote ya Israeli iliyokusanyika itachinja wanakondoo wake.
sw.R: Mtunzeni mnyama huyo mpaka siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi. Kisha jioni hiyo, jua linapotua, watu wote wa Israeli lazima wachinje wanyama wao.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 그것을 이 달 열나흗날까지 지켜 두었다가, 이스라엘 회중의 온 총회가 두 저녁 사이에 그것을 잡아야 한다.
ko.B: 이 달 열나흗날까지 그것을 잘 돌보아라. 그날 해 질 무렵에 이스라엘 온 회중이 저마다 어린양을 잡아라.
ko.R: 그 짐승을 그달 열나흗날까지 잘 돌보아야 한다. 그날 해가 질 때, 이스라엘 백성은 모두 자기 짐승을 잡아야 한다.

vi.L: Các ngươi phải giữ nó cho đến ngày mười bốn tháng này, rồi toàn thể hội của hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên phải giết nó giữa hai buổi chiều.
vi.B: Hãy giữ nó cho đến ngày mười bốn tháng này. Vào ngày đó, lúc chạng vạng, toàn thể hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên nhóm lại phải giết các con chiên con của mình.
vi.R: Hãy chăm giữ con vật cho đến ngày mười bốn tháng ấy. Rồi chiều hôm đó, lúc mặt trời lặn, toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải giết con vật của mình.

pt.L: E ele ficará guardado com vocês até o décimo quarto dia deste mês, e toda a assembleia da comunidade de Israel o abaterá entre as duas tardes.
pt.B: Guardem o animal até o dia catorze deste mês. Nesse dia, ao entardecer, toda a comunidade de Israel reunida abaterá os seus cordeiros.
pt.R: Cuidem do animal até o dia catorze do mês. Então, quando o sol estiver se pondo naquele dia, todo o povo de Israel tem de matar os seus animais.

am.L: እስከዚህም ወር እስከ አሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ድረስ በእናንተ ዘንድ ይጠበቅ፤ የእስራኤልም ማኅበር ጉባኤ ሁሉ በሁለቱ ምሽቶች መካከል ያርደዋል።
am.B: እስከዚህ ወር አሥራ አራተኛ ቀን ድረስ ጠብቁት። በዚያ ቀን ሲመሽ የእስራኤል ማኅበር ጉባኤ ሁሉ ጠቦቶቹን ያርዳል።
am.R: እስከ ወሩ አሥራ አራተኛ ቀን ድረስ እንስሳውን ተንከባከቡት። ከዚያም በዚያ ቀን ፀሐይ ስትጠልቅ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ እንስሶቻቸውን ማረድ አለባቸው።

hi.L: और वह इस महीने के चौदहवें दिन तक तुम्हारे पास रखा रहे, और इस्राएल की मंडली की सारी सभा उसे दोनों साँझों के बीच वध करे।
hi.B: इस महीने के चौदहवें दिन तक उसकी देखभाल करना। उस दिन, जब साँझ ढलने लगे, इस्राएल की पूरी इकट्ठी मंडली अपने-अपने मेम्ने का वध करे।
hi.R: चौदहवें दिन तक उस जानवर की देखभाल करना। फिर उस शाम, जब सूरज डूब रहा हो, इस्राएल के सब लोगों को अपने-अपने जानवर काटने होंगे।

ru.L: И будет он у вас под охраной до четырнадцатого дня этого месяца, и заколет его всё собрание общины Израиля между двумя вечерами.
ru.B: Берегите его до четырнадцатого дня этого месяца. В этот день, когда наступает вечер, всё собрание общины Израиля пусть заколет своих ягнят.
ru.R: Заботьтесь о животном до четырнадцатого дня месяца. Потом, когда в тот вечер солнце будет садиться, весь народ Израиля должен заколоть своих животных.

uk.L: І буде воно у вас на збереженні до чотирнадцятого дня цього місяця, і заколе його все зібрання громади Ізраїля між двома вечорами.
uk.B: Доглядайте його до чотирнадцятого дня цього місяця. Того дня надвечір усе зібрання громади Ізраїля має заколоти своїх ягнят.
uk.R: Доглядайте тварину до чотирнадцятого дня місяця. Тоді, коли заходитиме сонце, усі ізраїльтяни мусять заколоти своїх тварин.

decisions.choice: between the two evenings: at twilight, as the day ends
alternatives: in the late afternoon, before sunset
decisions.reason: The phrase is used for the Passover (Leviticus 23:5; Numbers 9:3) and for the daily evening offering (29:39-41). Its exact meaning is uncertain. It may mean between sunset and dark, or between the sun's turning toward evening in the afternoon and sunset. Deuteronomy 16:6 says the Passover is slaughtered "in the evening, at the going down of the sun".

decisions.choice: all the assembly of the congregation: the whole people, at one time
decisions.reason: Each household slaughters its own animal (verse 3), but all of Israel does it together, at the same hour. "It" is the lamb of each household.

decisions.choice: for keeping: kept safe and watched over
decisions.reason: The animal is chosen on the tenth day and kept with care for four days, so that it stays unblemished until the fourteenth.

decisions.choice: their lambs / their animals
decisions.reason: "It" means each household's animal, so Balanced and Readable use the plural.

decisions.choice: "hội của hội chúng" (L) for "the assembly of the congregation"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "hội" for the assembly (qahal) and "hội chúng" for the congregation (ʿedah); Literal keeps both words, and Balanced joins them as "toàn thể hội chúng ... nhóm lại".

decisions.choice: "두 저녁 사이에" at Literal; "해 질 무렵" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew expression, footnoted in the meaning decision; the other levels give its sense, twilight as the day ends.

decisions.choice: entre as duas tardes (L); ao entardecer (B); quando o sol estiver se pondo (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, whose exact sense is uncertain (m1); Balanced and Readable say the time of day as the English does, at the end of the afternoon as evening falls.

decisions.choice: "በሁለቱ ምሽቶች መካከል" (between the two evenings) at Literal; "ሲመሽ" (as evening falls) at Balanced, "ፀሐይ ስትጠልቅ" (as the sun goes down) at Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; the others say what it means, twilight.

decisions.choice: "सभा" for the assembly (qahal) beside "मंडली" for the congregation (ʿedah)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps the two Hebrew words apart: सभा for the assembly, मंडली for the congregation.

decisions.choice: "собрание общины"
decisions.reason: The note keeps "собрание" for qahal and "община" for ʿedah, so the pair here is "всё собрание общины Израиля": the whole people gathered at one time.

decisions.choice: "між двома вечорами" (L); "надвечір" (B); "коли заходитиме сонце" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable say the time it means (m1).

source.text: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן־הַדָּ֔ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַמְּזוּזֹ֖ת וְעַל־הַמַּשְׁק֑וֹף עַ֚ל הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יֹאכְל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will take from the blood and put [it] on the two doorposts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they will eat it.

en.L: And they shall take some of the blood and put [it] on the two doorposts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they eat it.
en.B: Some of the blood is to go on the two doorposts and on the lintel of each house where the lamb is eaten.
en.R: Then they must take some of the blood and smear it on the door frame of each house where they will eat the meat: on both side posts and on the beam across the top.

es.L: Y tomarán de la sangre y [la] pondrán sobre los dos postes y sobre el dintel, en las casas en que lo coman.
es.B: Se pondrá un poco de la sangre en los dos postes y en el dintel de cada casa donde se coma el cordero.
es.R: Luego tienen que tomar un poco de sangre y untarla en el marco de la puerta de cada casa donde vayan a comer la carne: en los dos lados y en la viga de arriba.

fr.L: Et ils prendront du sang et [le] mettront sur les deux montants et sur le linteau, sur les maisons dans lesquelles ils le mangeront.
fr.B: On mettra un peu du sang sur les deux montants et sur le linteau de chaque maison où l’on mangera l’agneau.
fr.R: Puis ils doivent prendre un peu de sang et l’étaler sur le cadre de la porte de chaque maison où ils mangeront la viande : sur les deux côtés et sur la poutre du haut.

sw.L: Nao watatwaa baadhi ya damu na kuiweka juu ya miimo miwili na juu ya kizingiti cha juu, katika nyumba ambazo watamla ndani yake.
sw.B: Sehemu ya damu itapakwa kwenye miimo miwili na kwenye kizingiti cha juu cha kila nyumba ambamo mwanakondoo ataliwa.
sw.R: Kisha lazima wachukue damu kidogo na kuipaka kwenye fremu ya mlango wa kila nyumba ambamo watakula nyama: kwenye nguzo zote mbili za pembeni na kwenye ubao wa juu.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그 피를 가져다가, 그것을 먹을 집들의 두 문설주와 문 위 가로대에 발라야 한다.
ko.B: 그 피를 조금 가져다가, 어린양을 먹을 집의 두 문설주와 문 위 가로대에 발라라.
ko.R: 그리고 그 피를 조금 가져다가, 고기를 먹을 집의 문틀에 발라야 한다. 문 양쪽 기둥과 문 위에 가로지른 나무에 발라야 한다.

vi.L: Họ phải lấy một ít máu bôi trên hai cây cột cửa và trên mày cửa của những nhà mà họ sẽ ăn nó.
vi.B: Họ phải lấy một ít máu bôi lên hai cột cửa và mày cửa của mỗi nhà nơi họ ăn chiên con.
vi.R: Sau đó họ phải lấy một ít máu bôi lên khung cửa của mỗi nhà nơi họ sẽ ăn thịt: bôi lên hai cột hai bên và lên thanh ngang phía trên.

pt.L: E tomarão do sangue e [o] porão nos dois batentes e na verga, nas casas em que o comerem.
pt.B: Um pouco do sangue será posto nos dois batentes e na verga de cada casa onde o cordeiro for comido.
pt.R: Depois, eles têm de pegar um pouco do sangue e passar na moldura da porta de cada casa onde vão comer a carne: nos dois lados e na viga de cima.

am.L: ከደሙም ወስደው በሚበሉበት ቤት ሁለቱ መቃኖችና በጉበኑ ላይ ያድርጉት።
am.B: ጠቦቱ በሚበላበት በእያንዳንዱ ቤት ከደሙ ጥቂቱ በሁለቱ መቃኖችና በጉበኑ ላይ ይቀባ።
am.R: ከዚያም ከደሙ ጥቂት ወስደው ሥጋውን በሚበሉበት ቤት ሁሉ በበሩ ፍሬም ላይ መቀባት አለባቸው፤ በሁለቱም የጎን ቋሚዎችና ከላይ ባለው አግዳሚ እንጨት ላይ ይቀቡት።

hi.L: और वे उस लहू में से कुछ लें और उसे उन घरों के द्वार के दोनों बाज़ुओं पर और ऊपर की चौखट पर लगाएँ जिनमें वे उसे खाएँगे।
hi.B: जिस-जिस घर में मेम्ना खाया जाए, उसके द्वार के दोनों बाज़ुओं और ऊपर की चौखट पर थोड़ा लहू लगाया जाए।
hi.R: फिर उन्हें थोड़ा लहू लेकर हर उस घर के दरवाज़े की चौखट पर लगाना होगा जिसमें वे मांस खाएँगे: दोनों तरफ़ के खंभों पर और ऊपर की लकड़ी पर।

ru.L: И возьмут от крови и нанесут на оба косяка и на притолоку, на домах, в которых будут есть его.
ru.B: Часть крови пусть нанесут на оба косяка и на притолоку каждого дома, где будут есть ягнёнка.
ru.R: Потом пусть возьмут немного крови и помажут ею дверную раму каждого дома, где будут есть мясо: оба боковых столба и верхнюю перекладину.

uk.L: І візьмуть з крові, і помажуть [нею] два одвірки і верхній одвірок на домах, у яких вони їстимуть його.
uk.B: Трохи крові треба помазати на обидва одвірки й на верхній одвірок кожного дому, де їстимуть ягня.
uk.R: Потім вони мають узяти трохи крові й помазати нею дверну раму кожного дому, де їстимуть мʼясо: обидва бічні одвірки й перекладину над дверима.

decisions.choice: the two doorposts and the lintel: the frame of the doorway
decisions.reason: The doorposts are the upright posts on either side of the door, and the lintel is the beam across the top. The blood marks the entrance, the boundary between the house and the night outside (verses 22-23).

decisions.choice: door frame ... side posts ... the beam across the top
decisions.reason: Readable explains "doorposts" and "lintel". Literal and Balanced keep the terms.

decisions.choice: "máu" for the blood
decisions.reason: The everyday word for blood, used for the blood of sacrifice and rite as for the plague; Exodus to Deuteronomy say "máu" throughout. The older church word "huyết" (kept in the project's Hebrews 9) is the alternative.

decisions.choice: "መቃን" (doorpost) and "ጉበን" (lintel)
decisions.reason: The words for the frame of a doorway; Readable describes the frame in plain words, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְאָכְל֥וּ אֶת־הַבָּשָׂ֖ר בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַזֶּ֑ה צְלִי־אֵ֣שׁ וּמַצּ֔וֹת עַל־מְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will eat the meat in this night, roasted [with] fire, and unleavened bread with bitter herbs they will eat it.

en.L: And they shall eat the meat in this night, roasted with fire; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
en.B: The meat is to be eaten that night, fire-roasted, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
en.R: They must roast the meat over a fire and eat it that night. They must eat it with bread made without yeast and with bitter herbs.

es.L: Y comerán la carne en esta noche, asada al fuego; con panes sin levadura y hierbas amargas la comerán.
es.B: La carne se comerá esa noche, asada al fuego, con panes sin levadura y hierbas amargas.
es.R: Tienen que asar la carne al fuego y comerla esa noche. Deben comerla con pan hecho sin levadura y con hierbas amargas.

fr.L: Et ils mangeront la viande en cette nuit, rôtie au feu ; avec des pains sans levain et des herbes amères ils la mangeront.
fr.B: La viande sera mangée cette nuit-là, rôtie au feu, avec des pains sans levain et des herbes amères.
fr.R: Ils doivent faire rôtir la viande sur le feu et la manger cette nuit-là. Ils la mangeront avec du pain fait sans levure et avec des herbes amères.

sw.L: Nao watakula nyama usiku huu, iliyochomwa kwa moto; pamoja na mikate isiyotiwa chachu na mboga chungu wataila.
sw.B: Nyama italiwa usiku huo, ikiwa imechomwa motoni, pamoja na mikate isiyotiwa chachu na mboga chungu.
sw.R: Lazima wachome nyama motoni na kuila usiku huo. Waile pamoja na mikate isiyotiwa chachu na mboga chungu.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그 밤에 그 고기를 불에 구워서 먹어야 한다. 누룩 없는 빵과 쓴 나물과 함께 그것을 먹어야 한다.
ko.B: 그 고기는 그날 밤에 불에 구워서, 누룩 없는 빵과 쓴 나물을 곁들여 먹어라.
ko.R: 고기는 불에 구워서 그날 밤에 먹어야 한다. 누룩을 넣지 않은 빵과 쓴 나물을 함께 먹어야 한다.

vi.L: Đêm ấy họ phải ăn thịt, nướng trên lửa; họ phải ăn nó với bánh không men và rau đắng.
vi.B: Đêm ấy họ phải ăn thịt nướng trên lửa, với bánh không men và rau đắng.
vi.R: Họ phải nướng thịt trên lửa và ăn ngay đêm đó. Họ phải ăn thịt với bánh làm không có men và với rau đắng.

pt.L: E comerão a carne nesta noite, assada no fogo; com pães sem fermento e ervas amargas a comerão.
pt.B: A carne será comida naquela noite, assada no fogo, com pães sem fermento e ervas amargas.
pt.R: Eles têm de assar a carne no fogo e comê-la naquela noite. Têm de comê-la com pão feito sem fermento e com ervas amargas.

am.L: በዚያችም ሌሊት ሥጋውን በእሳት ተጠብሶ ይብሉት፤ ከቂጣና ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይብሉት።
am.B: ሥጋው በዚያች ሌሊት በእሳት ተጠብሶ ከቂጣና ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይበላ።
am.R: ሥጋውን በእሳት ጠብሰው በዚያች ሌሊት መብላት አለባቸው። ያለ እርሾ ከተጋገረ ቂጣና ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይብሉት።

hi.L: और वे उसी रात मांस खाएँ, आग में भुना हुआ; अख़मीरी रोटी और कड़वे साग के साथ वे उसे खाएँ।
hi.B: मांस उसी रात खाया जाए, आग में भुना हुआ, अख़मीरी रोटी और कड़वे साग के साथ।
hi.R: उन्हें मांस आग पर भूनकर उसी रात खाना होगा। उसके साथ उन्हें बिना ख़मीर की रोटी और कड़वी पत्तियाँ खानी होंगी।

ru.L: И пусть едят мясо в эту ночь, жаренное на огне; с пресным хлебом [и] с горькими травами пусть едят его.
ru.B: Мясо пусть съедят в ту же ночь, зажаренным на огне, с пресным хлебом и горькими травами.
ru.R: Пусть зажарят мясо на огне и съедят его той ночью. Есть его нужно с хлебом без закваски и с горькими травами.

uk.L: І їстимуть мʼясо цієї ночі, спечене на вогні; з опрісноками і гіркими травами їстимуть його.
uk.B: Мʼясо треба зʼїсти тієї ночі, спечене на вогні, з опрісноками й гіркими травами.
uk.R: Вони мають спекти мʼясо на вогні й зʼїсти його тієї ночі. Їсти його треба з хлібом без закваски й з гіркими травами.

decisions.choice: unleavened bread: flat bread made without leaven
decisions.reason: The dough was baked without a lump of fermented dough to make it rise, so it could be made quickly. Verses 34 and 39 tell how the people left in such haste that their dough had no time to rise.

decisions.choice: bitter herbs: bitter plants, kinds not named
decisions.reason: The word means bitter things, here bitter leaves eaten with the meal. The text does not say what they stand for. The same root is used in 1:14, where the Egyptians made the Israelites' lives bitter.

decisions.choice: bread made without yeast
decisions.reason: Readable says "yeast" for leaven. In ancient times bread was raised with a piece of old, fermented dough, not with yeast as it is sold today, but the effect is the same.

decisions.choice: "pain fait sans levure" at Readable; "pains sans levain" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "yeast" for leaven, French Readable says "levure", the everyday word, while Literal and Balanced keep "levain", the fermented dough of the Hebrew. The feast keeps its name, "la fête des Pains sans levain", at every level.

decisions.choice: "kuchoma" for roasting the meat over the fire
decisions.reason: "Kuchoma nyama" is roasting meat on or over an open fire; "kuoka" is baking in an oven, used below for the bread (verse 39).

decisions.choice: "누룩 없는 빵" for matsot, at every level
decisions.reason: The Korean New Testament uses "빵", never "떡", and "누룩 없는 빵" says what the bread is; "무교병" is a Sino-Korean church word few readers can parse. The feast itself keeps its established name, "무교절" (12:17). This holds for these chapters.

decisions.choice: pães sem fermento; o fermento
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "pães sem fermento" says plainly what the bread is (m1); "ázimos" is a learned word few readers know. Portuguese "fermento" covers both the old fermented dough and modern yeast, so the English Readable's change to "yeast" (r-en-1) needs no different word here: every level says "fermento".

decisions.choice: "ቂጣ" (unleavened bread); Readable adds "ያለ እርሾ የተጋገረ" (baked without yeast)
decisions.reason: "ቂጣ" is the everyday Amharic word for flat bread made without leaven; Readable spells out what makes it so, as the English Readable does. Leaven is "እርሾ".

decisions.choice: "बिना ख़मीर की रोटी" for unleavened bread
decisions.reason: Readable says what the bread is in everyday words; Literal and Balanced keep the term अख़मीरी रोटी. ख़मीर is the leaven of Matthew.

decisions.choice: "пресный хлеб"
decisions.reason: "Пресный хлеб" is the plain modern word for flat bread made without leaven; "опресноки" is a church word, and "маца" names the later Jewish bread. The feast is "праздник Пресных хлебов", as the Pentateuch note settles.

decisions.choice: "хлеб без закваски"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term. Russian "закваска" (as in 1 Corinthians 5:7) is the right word for the old fermented dough that raised bread in ancient times, where the English Readable says "yeast".

decisions.choice: "опрісноки" (L, B); "хліб без закваски" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "опрісноки" for the unleavened bread and the feast at L and B; Readable says what it is.

source.text: אַל־תֹּאכְל֤וּ מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ נָ֔א וּבָשֵׁ֥ל מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל בַּמָּ֑יִם כִּ֣י אִם־צְלִי־אֵ֔שׁ רֹאשׁ֥וֹ עַל־כְּרָעָ֖יו וְעַל־קִרְבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not eat from it raw or boiled, boiled in water, but rather roasted [with] fire, its head with its legs and with its inner parts.

en.L: Do not eat any of it raw, or boiled, boiled in water, but roasted with fire, its head with its legs and with its inner parts.
en.B: None of it is to be eaten raw or stewed in water. It must be roasted in the fire whole, with its head, its legs, and its inner organs.
en.R: Do not eat it raw, and do not boil it in water. Roast the whole animal over a fire, including its head, legs, and insides.

es.L: No {{plural_you:coman|comáis}} de él nada crudo, ni cocido, cocido en agua, sino asado al fuego, su cabeza con sus patas y con sus entrañas.
es.B: No {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} nada de él crudo ni guisado en agua; ha de asarse entero al fuego, con la cabeza, las patas y las vísceras.
es.R: No {{plural_you:coman|comáis}} la carne cruda, ni la {{plural_you:hiervan|hirváis}} en agua. {{plural_you:Asen|Asad}} el animal entero al fuego, con la cabeza, las patas y las tripas.

fr.L: N’en mangez rien cru, ni bouilli, bouilli dans l’eau, mais rôti au feu, sa tête avec ses pattes et avec ses entrailles.
fr.B: Vous n’en mangerez rien de cru ni de cuit à l’eau : il sera rôti au feu tout entier, avec la tête, les pattes et les entrailles.
fr.R: Ne mangez pas la viande crue, et ne la faites pas bouillir dans l’eau. Faites rôtir l’animal entier sur le feu, avec la tête, les pattes et l’intérieur.

sw.L: Msile kitu chake kibichi, wala kilichochemshwa, kilichochemshwa katika maji, bali kilichochomwa kwa moto, kichwa chake pamoja na miguu yake na pamoja na matumbo yake.
sw.B: Msile sehemu yake yoyote ikiwa mbichi wala iliyopikwa majini; ni lazima achomwe motoni mzima, pamoja na kichwa, miguu na viungo vya ndani.
sw.R: Msile nyama mbichi, wala msiichemshe majini. Mchomeni mnyama mzima motoni, pamoja na kichwa chake, miguu na matumbo.

ko.L: 너희는 그것을 날로나 삶아서, 물에 삶아서 먹지 말고, 오직 불에 구워서 [먹어라]. 그 머리와 다리와 내장까지 [구워라].
ko.B: 날것으로 먹거나 물에 삶아 먹지 말고, 머리와 다리와 내장까지 통째로 불에 구워 먹어라.
ko.R: 고기를 날로 먹으면 안 된다. 물에 삶아 먹어도 안 된다. 머리와 다리와 내장까지 짐승 전체를 불에 구워야 한다.

vi.L: Đừng ăn nó sống hay luộc, luộc trong nước, mà phải nướng trên lửa, cả đầu với chân và bộ lòng.
vi.B: Không được ăn thịt sống hay nấu trong nước, nhưng phải nướng nguyên con trên lửa, cả đầu, chân và bộ lòng.
vi.R: Đừng ăn sống, cũng đừng luộc trong nước. Hãy nướng nguyên con trên lửa, cả đầu, chân và bộ lòng.

pt.L: Não comam dele [nada] cru, nem cozido, cozido em água, mas assado no fogo, a sua cabeça com as suas pernas e com as suas entranhas.
pt.B: Não comam nada dele cru nem cozido em água. Tem de ser assado inteiro no fogo, com a cabeça, as pernas e as entranhas.
pt.R: Não comam a carne crua e não a cozinhem na água. Assem o animal inteiro no fogo, com a cabeça, as pernas e as partes de dentro.

am.L: ጥሬውን ወይም የተቀቀለውን፣ በውኃ የተቀቀለውን፣ ከእርሱ አትብሉ፤ ነገር ግን ራሱን ከእግሮቹና ከሆድ ዕቃው ጋር በእሳት የተጠበሰውን [ብሉ]።
am.B: ከእርሱ ጥሬውንም ሆነ በውኃ የተቀቀለውን ምንም አትብሉ። ራሱን፣ እግሮቹንና ሆድ ዕቃውን ሳትለያዩ ሙሉውን በእሳት ጠብሱት።
am.R: ጥሬውን አትብሉ፤ በውኃም አትቀቅሉት። እንስሳውን ራሱን፣ እግሮቹንና ሆድ ዕቃውን ጨምሮ ሙሉውን በእሳት ጠብሱት።

hi.L: उसमें से कुछ भी कच्चा या पानी में उबाला हुआ, उबाला हुआ न खाना, परन्तु आग में भुना हुआ, उसका सिर उसके पैरों और उसकी अंतड़ियों समेत।
hi.B: उसमें से कुछ भी कच्चा या पानी में पकाया हुआ न खाया जाए। उसे पूरा का पूरा आग में भूना जाए, सिर, पैरों और भीतरी अंगों समेत।
hi.R: उसे कच्चा मत खाना, और पानी में उबालना भी मत। पूरे जानवर को आग पर भूनना, उसका सिर, पैर और अंदर के हिस्से भी।

ru.L: Не ешьте от него сырого или варёного, сваренного в воде, но только жаренное на огне, голову его с ногами его и с внутренностями его.
ru.B: Не ешьте его ни сырым, ни сваренным в воде. Оно должно быть целиком зажарено на огне: с головой, ногами и внутренностями.
ru.R: Не ешьте его сырым и не варите в воде. Зажарьте всё животное на огне, вместе с головой, ногами и внутренностями.

uk.L: Не їжте з нього сирого чи вареного, звареного у воді, а лише спечене на вогні, його голову з його ногами і з його нутрощами.
uk.B: Не їжте з нього нічого сирого чи звареного у воді. Його треба спекти на вогні цілим, з головою, ногами й нутрощами.
uk.R: Не їжте його сирим і не варіть у воді. Спечіть тварину на вогні цілою, разом з головою, ногами й нутрощами.

decisions.choice: boiled, boiled in water: in no way cooked in water
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated for emphasis: the meat must not be cooked in water at all, only roasted.

decisions.choice: its head with its legs and its inner parts: the animal roasted whole
decisions.reason: The animal is cooked in one piece, not cut up into portions. Verse 46 adds that none of its bones may be broken.

decisions.choice: whole
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "whole", which the list of head, legs and inner parts implies.

source.text: וְלֹא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר וְהַנֹּתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר בָּאֵ֥שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And not you will leave from it until morning; and the [part] remaining from it until morning in the fire you will burn.

en.L: And you shall not leave any of it until morning; and what remains of it until morning you shall burn with fire.
en.B: None of it may be kept until morning; whatever is still uneaten at daybreak must be burned in the fire.
en.R: Eat all of it that night. If any is left the next morning, you must burn it.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:dejarán|dejaréis}} nada de él hasta la mañana; y lo que quede de él hasta la mañana lo {{plural_you:quemarán|quemaréis}} en el fuego.
es.B: No {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} nada para la mañana; lo que al amanecer no se haya comido lo {{plural_you:quemarán|quemaréis}} en el fuego.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cómanselo|Coméoslo}} todo esa noche. Si sobra algo a la mañana siguiente, {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que quemarlo.

fr.L: Et vous n’en laisserez rien jusqu’au matin ; et ce qui en restera jusqu’au matin, vous le brûlerez au feu.
fr.B: Vous n’en garderez rien jusqu’au matin ; ce qui ne sera pas mangé au lever du jour, vous le brûlerez au feu.
fr.R: Mangez tout pendant la nuit. S’il en reste le lendemain matin, vous devez le brûler.

sw.L: Wala msisaze kitu chake hadi asubuhi; na kilichobaki chake hadi asubuhi mtakiteketeza kwa moto.
sw.B: Msibakize kitu chochote hadi asubuhi; chochote ambacho hakijaliwa kufikia mapambazuko lazima kichomwe motoni.
sw.R: Mleni wote usiku ule. Kama kitu kitabaki asubuhi, lazima mkichome moto.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 아침까지 그것을 조금도 남겨 두지 말라. 아침까지 남은 것은 불에 태워라.
ko.B: 아침까지 아무것도 남겨 두지 말고, 아침까지 남은 것이 있으면 불에 태워라.
ko.R: 그날 밤에 고기를 다 먹어야 한다. 다음 날 아침까지 남은 것이 있으면 불에 태워야 한다.

vi.L: Các ngươi không được để lại chút gì của nó cho đến sáng; phần nào còn lại đến sáng, các ngươi phải đốt trong lửa.
vi.B: Không được để thừa lại chút nào cho đến sáng; phần nào còn đến sáng phải đốt đi trong lửa.
vi.R: Hãy ăn hết trong đêm đó. Nếu sáng hôm sau còn thừa, các ngươi phải đốt đi.

pt.L: E vocês não deixarão nada dele até a manhã; e o que restar dele até a manhã, vocês queimarão no fogo.
pt.B: Nada dele pode ficar para a manhã seguinte; o que ainda sobrar ao amanhecer deve ser queimado no fogo.
pt.R: Comam tudo naquela noite. Se sobrar alguma coisa na manhã seguinte, queimem tudo.

am.L: ከእርሱም እስከ ጠዋት ምንም አታስቀሩ፤ ከእርሱ እስከ ጠዋት የቀረውንም በእሳት አቃጥሉት።
am.B: ከእርሱ ምንም እስከ ጠዋት አይቆይ፤ ሲነጋ ሳይበላ የቀረውን ሁሉ በእሳት አቃጥሉት።
am.R: በዚያች ሌሊት ሁሉንም ብሉት። በማግስቱ ጠዋት የቀረ ነገር ቢኖር ማቃጠል አለባችሁ።

hi.L: और तुम उसमें से कुछ भी सुबह तक न छोड़ना; और जो उसमें से सुबह तक बचा रहे, उसे तुम आग में जला देना।
hi.B: उसमें से कुछ भी सुबह तक न रखा जाए; जो कुछ भोर तक बिना खाए बचा रहे, उसे आग में जला दिया जाए।
hi.R: सारा मांस उसी रात खा लेना। अगर अगली सुबह कुछ बचा रहे, तो तुम्हें उसे जला देना होगा।

ru.L: И не оставляйте от него до утра; а оставшееся от него до утра сожгите в огне.
ru.B: Ничего не оставляйте до утра; всё, что не будет съедено к рассвету, сожгите в огне.
ru.R: Съешьте всё за эту ночь. Если что-то останется до утра, это нужно сжечь.

uk.L: І не залишайте з нього до ранку; а що залишиться з нього до ранку, спаліть у вогні.
uk.B: Нічого з нього не залишайте до ранку; усе, що лишиться недоїденим на світанку, треба спалити у вогні.
uk.R: Зʼїжте все тієї ж ночі. Якщо щось залишиться до ранку, ви мусите це спалити.

decisions.choice: burn what remains: the meal is not kept for ordinary use
decisions.reason: Leftovers of some holy meals had to be burned, not saved and eaten later (29:34; Leviticus 7:15). The Passover is eaten in one night and finished.

decisions.choice: Eat all of it that night
decisions.reason: Readable states the command positively: leaving nothing until morning means eating it all that night.

source.text: וְכָכָה֮ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹתוֹ֒ מָתְנֵיכֶ֣ם חֲגֻרִ֔ים נַֽעֲלֵיכֶם֙ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּמַקֶּלְכֶ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּחִפָּז֔וֹן פֶּ֥סַח ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And thus you will eat it: your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you will eat it in haste. A passover it [is] to Yahweh.

en.L: And thus you shall eat it: your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste. It [is] a Passover to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: When you eat it, be ready to set out: robes tucked into your belts, sandals on, staffs in hand. Eat it quickly. It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s Passover.
en.R: Eat the meal dressed and ready to leave. Tie up your robes, put on your sandals, and hold your staff. Eat fast. This is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s Passover.

es.L: Y así lo {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}}: {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} lomos ceñidos, {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} sandalias en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pies y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} bastón en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mano; y lo {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} de prisa. Es una Pascua para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cuando lo {{plural_you:coman|comáis}}, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} listos para partir: la ropa recogida en el cinturón, las sandalias puestas y el bastón en la mano. {{plural_you:Cómanlo|Comedlo}} de prisa. Es la Pascua {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Coman|Comed}} vestidos y listos para salir. {{plural_you:Átense|Ataos}} la ropa a la cintura, {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} las sandalias y {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} el bastón en la mano. {{plural_you:Coman|Comed}} rápido. Esta es la Pascua {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et c’est ainsi que vous le mangerez : vos reins ceints, vos sandales à vos pieds et votre bâton à votre main ; et vous le mangerez en hâte. C’est une Pâque pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Quand vous le mangerez, soyez prêts à partir : vos vêtements relevés dans votre ceinture, les sandales aux pieds, le bâton à la main. Vous le mangerez en hâte. C’est la Pâque {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mangez ce repas habillés et prêts à partir. Attachez vos vêtements à la ceinture, mettez vos sandales et prenez votre bâton à la main. Mangez vite. C’est la Pâque {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na hivi ndivyo mtakavyomla: viuno vyenu vimefungwa, viatu vyenu miguuni mwenu, na fimbo yenu mkononi mwenu; nanyi mtamla kwa haraka. Ni Pasaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtakapomla, muwe tayari kwa safari: nguo zenu zimekazwa kiunoni, viatu miguuni, fimbo mkononi. Mleni kwa haraka. Ni Pasaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mle chakula hicho mkiwa mmevaa na tayari kuondoka. Fungeni nguo zenu kiunoni, vaeni viatu vyenu, na mshike fimbo zenu. Kuleni haraka. Hii ni Pasaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 이렇게 그것을 먹어라. 허리에 띠를 띠고, 발에 신을 신고, 손에 지팡이를 잡고, 서둘러 그것을 먹어라. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 유월절이다.
ko.B: 그것을 먹을 때에는 길 떠날 차림을 하여라. 옷자락을 허리띠에 단단히 매고, 신을 신고, 지팡이를 손에 들고, 서둘러 먹어라. 이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 유월절이다.
ko.R: 떠날 준비를 한 채로 먹어야 한다. 겉옷을 허리에 묶고, 신을 신고, 지팡이를 손에 들어야 한다. 서둘러 먹어야 한다. 이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 유월절이다.

vi.L: Các ngươi phải ăn nó như thế này: lưng thắt lại, chân mang dép, tay cầm gậy; các ngươi phải ăn vội vàng. Đó [là] Lễ Vượt Qua của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Khi ăn, các ngươi phải sẵn sàng lên đường: áo vén lên giắt vào thắt lưng, chân mang dép, tay cầm gậy. Hãy ăn vội vàng. Đó là Lễ Vượt Qua của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hãy ăn bữa ấy trong tư thế sẵn sàng ra đi. Hãy buộc áo lên, mang dép vào và cầm gậy trong tay. Hãy ăn thật nhanh. Đây là Lễ Vượt Qua của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

pt.L: E assim vocês o comerão: os lombos cingidos, as sandálias nos pés e o cajado na mão; e o comerão às pressas. [É] uma Páscoa {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}.
pt.B: Quando o comerem, estejam prontos para partir: as roupas presas no cinto, as sandálias nos pés, o cajado na mão. Comam depressa. É a Páscoa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Comam a refeição vestidos e prontos para sair. Prendam as roupas no cinto, calcem as sandálias e segurem o cajado. Comam depressa. Esta é a Páscoa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: እንዲህም ትበሉታላችሁ፦ ወገባችሁን ታጥቃችሁ፣ ጫማችሁን በእግራችሁ፣ በትራችሁንም በእጃችሁ ይዛችሁ፤ ፈጥናችሁም ትበሉታላችሁ። ይህ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ፋሲካ [ነው]።
am.B: በምትበሉት ጊዜ ለጉዞ ተዘጋጁ፤ ልብሳችሁን በወገባችሁ ታጠቁ፤ ጫማችሁን አድርጉ፤ በትራችሁንም በእጃችሁ ያዙ። በችኮላ ብሉት። ይህ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ፋሲካ ነው።
am.R: ለመሄድ ተዘጋጅታችሁ ምግቡን ብሉ። ልብሳችሁን በወገባችሁ ሰብስባችሁ እሰሩ፤ ጫማችሁን አድርጉ፤ በትራችሁንም ያዙ። ቶሎ ብሉ። ይህ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ፋሲካ ነው።

hi.L: और तुम उसे इस प्रकार खाना: तुम्हारी कमर कसी हुई, तुम्हारी जूतियाँ तुम्हारे पैरों में, और तुम्हारी लाठी तुम्हारे हाथ में; और तुम उसे उतावली से खाना। यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए फ़सह [है]।
hi.B: जब तुम उसे खाओ, तब चल पड़ने को तैयार रहना: वस्त्र कमरबंद में खोंसे हुए, पैरों में जूतियाँ, हाथ में लाठी। उसे जल्दी-जल्दी खाना। यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का फ़सह है।
hi.R: खाना खाते समय निकलने को तैयार रहना। अपने कपड़े कमर पर बाँध लेना, जूतियाँ पहन लेना और अपनी लाठी हाथ में रखना। जल्दी-जल्दी खाना। यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का फ़सह है।

ru.L: И так ешьте его: бёдра ваши препоясаны, сандалии ваши на ногах ваших и посох ваш в руке вашей; и ешьте его в спешке. Это Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Ешьте его готовыми к пути: одежда подпоясана, сандалии на ногах, посох в руке. Ешьте быстро. Это Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Ешьте, одевшись и приготовившись уйти. Подвяжите одежду поясом, обуйте сандалии и держите в руке посох. Ешьте быстро. Это Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

uk.L: І так їстимете його: стегна ваші підперезані, ваші сандалі на ваших ногах і ваша палиця у вашій руці; і їстимете його поспіхом. Це Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЯ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Коли їстимете його, будьте готові вирушати: одяг підперезаний, сандалі на ногах, палиця в руці. Їжте його поспіхом. Це Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЯ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Їжте вдягнені й готові вирушати в дорогу. Підпережіть одяг, узуйте сандалі й тримайте в руках палицю. Їжте швидко. Це Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЯ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: your loins girded: robe tied up at the waist, ready to travel
decisions.reason: A long robe was gathered up and tucked into a belt so that a person could walk, run or work freely (1 Kings 18:46; 2 Kings 4:29). With sandals on and staff in hand, they are to eat as people about to leave.

decisions.choice: in haste: in a hurry, with urgency
decisions.reason: The word means hurried flight and can carry a sense of alarm. Deuteronomy 16:3 uses it of the departure: "you came out of the land of Egypt in haste".

decisions.choice: Passover: named for Yahweh passing over the houses of Israel
decisions.reason: This is the first use of the noun. It comes from the verb used in verses 13, 23 and 27 for what Yahweh does at the houses marked with blood. The noun names the feast, the animal that is slaughtered (verse 21) and the sacrifice (verse 27). On the sense of the verb, "pass over" or "protect", see verse 13.

decisions.choice: robes tucked into your belts / Tie up your robes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain "loins girded" (m1). Literal keeps the idiom.

decisions.choice: "유월절" for pesach
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the Korean New Testament set. The Sino-Korean name itself means "passing over", so the link with "넘어가다" in 12:13, 23 and 27 (meaning decision) stays visible.

decisions.choice: "Lễ Vượt Qua" for the Passover
decisions.reason: The feast's name with "Lễ" capitalised, as Joshua and the New Testament in Vietnamese write it; the other feasts are written the same way ("Lễ Bánh Không Men", "Lễ Các Tuần", "Lễ Lều Tạm"). The name says that God passed over the houses of Israel (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: a Páscoa
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it: "Páscoa" is the name Portuguese gives this feast, taken through Latin from this very noun, and the name the New Testament uses in Portuguese. Its link with the verb of verse 13, which Portuguese renders "passar por cima", is lost in sound; the meaning note (m3) explains it. The traveller's staff here is "cajado", a different word from the "vara" of Moses and Aaron.

decisions.choice: "फ़सह" for the Passover
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's form for the feast named after Yahweh passing over Israel's houses, written with the nukta as the New Testament in this translation writes it.

decisions.choice: "Пасха"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles "Пасха", the word of the New Testament. In Russian it does not echo "пройти мимо" (12:13, 23, 27) as the Hebrew pesach echoes pasach; the English note m3 explains the name.

decisions.choice: "бёдра ваши препоясаны"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the image of the girded waist but uses the modern word "бёдра" rather than the Slavonic "чресла".

decisions.choice: "Пасха {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЯ|Ягве}}"
decisions.reason: "Пасха" is the settled word, as in the New Testament; the possessive adjective is inflected inside the default option only, since "Ягве" takes none.

source.text: וְעָבַרְתִּ֣י בְאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם֮ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַזֶּה֒ וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י כָל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־בְּהֵמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־אֱלֹהֵ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה שְׁפָטִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will pass through in [the] land of Egypt in this night, and I will strike every firstborn in [the] land of Egypt, from man and to beast; and on all [the] gods of Egypt I will do judgments. I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And I will pass through the land of Egypt in this night, and I will strike every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from man to beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: This very night I will go through the land of Egypt and strike down every firstborn in it, human and animal alike. Against all the gods of Egypt I will carry out judgments. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: That night I will go through Egypt. I will kill the oldest son in every family and every firstborn male animal. I will judge all the gods of Egypt. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y pasaré por la tierra de Egipto en esta noche, y heriré a todo primogénito en la tierra de Egipto, desde el hombre hasta la bestia; y contra todos los dioses de Egipto ejecutaré juicios. Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Esta misma noche recorreré la tierra de Egipto y abatiré a todo primogénito en ella, tanto de personas como de animales. Contra todos los dioses de Egipto llevaré a cabo juicios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Esa noche pasaré por todo Egipto. Haré morir al hijo mayor de cada familia y a todos los primogénitos machos de los animales. Juzgaré a todos los dioses de Egipto. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je passerai à travers le pays d’Égypte en cette nuit, et je frapperai tout premier-né dans le pays d’Égypte, depuis l’homme jusqu’à la bête ; et contre tous les dieux de l’Égypte j’exercerai des jugements. Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Cette nuit même, je traverserai le pays d’Égypte et je frapperai tous les premiers-nés du pays, hommes et bêtes. Contre tous les dieux de l’Égypte, j’exécuterai des jugements. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Cette nuit-là, je traverserai l’Égypte. Je ferai mourir le fils aîné de chaque famille et tous les premiers-nés mâles des animaux. Je jugerai tous les dieux de l’Égypte. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitapita katika nchi ya Misri usiku huu, na nitampiga kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika nchi ya Misri, tangu mwanadamu hadi mnyama; na juu ya miungu yote ya Misri nitatekeleza hukumu. Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Usiku huu huu nitapita katika nchi ya Misri na kumpiga kila mzaliwa wa kwanza ndani yake, wa wanadamu na wa wanyama pia. Nitatekeleza hukumu juu ya miungu yote ya Misri. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Usiku huo nitapita katika Misri yote. Nitamuua mwana mkubwa wa kila jamaa, na kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa wanyama. Nitaihukumu miungu yote ya Misri. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 이 밤에 이집트 땅을 두루 지나가며, 이집트 땅의 모든 맏아들을 사람부터 짐승까지 치겠다. 그리고 이집트의 모든 신들에게 내가 심판을 행하겠다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.B: 바로 이 밤에 내가 이집트 땅을 두루 다니며, 그 땅의 맏아들과 짐승의 첫 새끼를 모두 치겠다. 또 이집트의 모든 신들을 내가 심판하겠다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.R: 그날 밤 나는 이집트를 두루 다니겠다. 집집마다 맏아들을 죽이고, 짐승의 첫 새끼 수컷도 다 죽이겠다. 나는 이집트의 모든 신들을 심판하겠다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.

vi.L: Đêm ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đi qua xứ Ai Cập, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh mọi con đầu lòng trong xứ Ai Cập, từ người cho đến thú vật; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thi hành sự đoán phạt trên mọi thần của Ai Cập. Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Chính đêm ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đi qua xứ Ai Cập và đánh chết mọi con đầu lòng trong xứ, cả người lẫn thú vật. Ta sẽ thi hành sự đoán phạt trên mọi thần của Ai Cập. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đêm đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đi khắp Ai Cập. Ta sẽ giết con trai trưởng trong mọi gia đình và mọi con đực đầu lòng của súc vật. Ta sẽ phán xét mọi thần của Ai Cập. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

pt.L: E eu passarei pela terra do Egito nesta noite, e ferirei todo primogênito na terra do Egito, desde o homem até o animal; e contra todos os deuses do Egito executarei juízos. Eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Nesta mesma noite passarei pela terra do Egito e ferirei de morte todo primogênito, tanto de gente como de animais. Executarei juízos contra todos os deuses do Egito. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Naquela noite vou passar pelo Egito. Vou matar o filho mais velho de cada família e todo primeiro filhote macho dos animais. Vou julgar todos os deuses do Egito. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: በዚያችም ሌሊት በግብፅ ምድር አልፋለሁ፤ በግብፅም ምድር ያለውን በኩር ሁሉ ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ እመታለሁ፤ በግብፅም አማልክት ሁሉ ላይ ፍርድን አደርጋለሁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]።
am.B: በዚችው ሌሊት በግብፅ ምድር አልፌ በውስጧ ያለውን በኩር ሁሉ፣ ሰውንም እንስሳንም እመታለሁ። በግብፅ አማልክት ሁሉ ላይ ፍርድን እፈጽማለሁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።
am.R: በዚያች ሌሊት በግብፅ አልፋለሁ። የየቤተሰቡን የመጀመሪያ ወንድ ልጅና የእንስሳትን የመጀመሪያ ተባዕት ሁሉ እገድላለሁ። በግብፅ አማልክት ሁሉ ላይ እፈርዳለሁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።

hi.L: और मैं इसी रात मिस्र देश में से होकर जाऊँगा, और मिस्र देश में मनुष्य से लेकर पशु तक हर पहलौठे को मारूँगा; और मिस्र के सब देवताओं पर मैं न्याय के काम करूँगा। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।
hi.B: इसी रात मैं मिस्र देश में से होकर जाऊँगा और उसमें हर पहलौठे को मार डालूँगा, चाहे मनुष्य हो या पशु। मिस्र के सब देवताओं पर मैं न्याय करूँगा। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।
hi.R: उस रात मैं पूरे मिस्र में से होकर जाऊँगा। मैं हर परिवार के सबसे बड़े बेटे को और पशुओं के हर पहलौठे नर को मार डालूँगा। मैं मिस्र के सब देवताओं का न्याय करूँगा। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।

ru.L: И пройду {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} по земле Египта в эту ночь, и поражу всякого первенца в земле Египта, от человека и до скота; и над всеми богами Египта совершу суды. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: В эту самую ночь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пройду по земле Египта и поражу в ней всякого первенца, и у людей, и у животных. Над всеми богами Египта {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} совершу суд. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: В ту ночь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пройду по Египту. Я убью старшего сына в каждой семье и каждого первородного самца у животных. Я буду судить всех богов Египта. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

uk.L: І пройду я землею Єгипту цієї ночі, і вражу кожного первістка в землі Єгипту, від людини до худоби; і над усіма богами Єгипту вчиню суди. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Цієї самої ночі я пройду через єгипетську землю й уражу в ній кожного первістка, і людей, і тварин. Над усіма богами Єгипту я вчиню суд. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тієї ночі я пройду через Єгипет. Я вбʼю найстаршого сина в кожній родині й кожного первородного самця серед тварин. Я засуджу всіх богів Єгипту. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: pass through: go across the land
decisions.reason: This is the ordinary verb for crossing or going through a place. It is a different word from the one in verse 13, "pass over", which gives the Passover its name.

decisions.choice: against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments
decisions.reason: The last plague is a judgment on the gods Egypt trusted, which cannot protect even Pharaoh's son. Numbers 33:4 looks back on it: "on their gods also Yahweh executed judgments".

decisions.choice: I am Yahweh: God's name sets his seal on the word
decisions.reason: The same short declaration closes many of God's words to Moses (6:2, 6, 8, 29). The judgment will show who Yahweh is (7:5).

decisions.choice: the oldest son in every family and every firstborn male animal
decisions.reason: Readable says "oldest son" for people, as in 11:5, and spells out that the firstborn of animals are the males.

decisions.choice: "አማልክት" for the gods of Egypt
decisions.reason: The plural "gods" is "አማልክት"; "አምላክ" and "እግዚአብሔር" are kept for God.

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ הַדָּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם לְאֹ֗ת עַ֤ל הַבָּתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם וְרָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וּפָסַחְתִּ֖י עֲלֵכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בָכֶ֥ם נֶ֨גֶף֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית בְּהַכֹּתִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be the blood for you for a sign on the houses where you [are] there; and I will see the blood and pass over you, and there will not be on you a plague for destruction when I strike in [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: And the blood shall be for you a sign on the houses where you [are]; and I will see the blood and I will pass over you, and no plague shall be on you for destruction when I strike the land of Egypt.
en.B: The blood will mark the houses where you are staying; it will be a sign for you. I will see the blood and pass over you, and the plague that destroys will not fall on you when I strike the land of Egypt.
en.R: The blood on your houses will be a sign for you. I will see the blood, and I will pass over you. The deadly plague will not touch you when I strike Egypt.

es.L: Y la sangre será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una señal sobre las casas donde {{plural_you:estén|estéis}}; y veré la sangre y pasaré de largo junto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y no habrá entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} plaga para destrucción cuando yo hiera la tierra de Egipto.
es.B: La sangre marcará las casas donde {{plural_you:estén|estéis}}: será una señal para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Veré la sangre y pasaré de largo, y la plaga destructora no caerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando yo hiera la tierra de Egipto.
es.R: La sangre en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} casas será una señal para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Veré la sangre y pasaré de largo. La plaga mortal no {{plural_you:los|os}} tocará cuando yo golpee a Egipto.

fr.L: Et le sang sera pour vous un signe sur les maisons où vous [êtes] ; et je verrai le sang et je passerai par-dessus vous, et aucun fléau ne sera sur vous pour [vous] détruire quand je frapperai le pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Le sang marquera les maisons où vous serez : ce sera un signe pour vous. Je verrai le sang et je passerai par-dessus vous, et le fléau qui détruit ne vous atteindra pas quand je frapperai le pays d’Égypte.
fr.R: Le sang sur vos maisons sera un signe pour vous. Je verrai le sang, et je passerai par-dessus vous. Le fléau mortel ne vous touchera pas quand je frapperai l’Égypte.

sw.L: Na damu itakuwa kwenu ishara juu ya nyumba mlimo; nami nitaiona damu na kuwapita, wala hapatakuwa na pigo kati yenu la kuangamiza nitakapoipiga nchi ya Misri.
sw.B: Damu itakuwa alama juu ya nyumba mnamokaa; itakuwa ishara kwenu. Nitakapoiona damu nitawapita, na pigo la maangamizi halitawapata nitakapoipiga nchi ya Misri.
sw.R: Damu kwenye nyumba zenu itakuwa ishara kwenu. Nitaiona damu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawapita. Pigo la mauti halitawagusa nitakapoipiga Misri.

ko.L: 그리고 그 피가 너희가 있는 집들 위에서 너희를 위한 표적이 될 것이다. 내가 그 피를 보고 너희를 넘어가겠다. 내가 이집트 땅을 칠 때에 멸망의 재앙이 너희에게 있지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그 피는 너희가 머무는 집에 표시가 되어, 너희에게 표적이 될 것이다. 내가 그 피를 보면 너희를 넘어가겠다. 내가 이집트 땅을 칠 때에 멸망시키는 재앙이 너희에게는 내리지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 너희 집에 바른 피가 너희를 위한 표적이 될 것이다. 나는 그 피를 보고 너희를 넘어가겠다. 내가 이집트를 칠 때에 죽음의 재앙이 너희에게는 닥치지 않을 것이다.

vi.L: Máu sẽ là một dấu hiệu cho các ngươi trên những nhà các ngươi ở; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thấy máu và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ vượt qua các ngươi, và sẽ không có tai vạ hủy diệt nào trên các ngươi khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh xứ Ai Cập.
vi.B: Máu trên những nhà các ngươi ở sẽ là dấu hiệu cho các ngươi. Ta sẽ thấy máu và vượt qua các ngươi, và tai vạ hủy diệt sẽ không giáng trên các ngươi khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh xứ Ai Cập.
vi.R: Máu trên nhà các ngươi sẽ là một dấu hiệu cho các ngươi. Ta sẽ thấy máu và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ vượt qua các ngươi. Tai vạ chết chóc sẽ không đụng đến các ngươi khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh phạt Ai Cập.

pt.L: E o sangue será para vocês um sinal nas casas onde vocês [estiverem]; e eu verei o sangue e passarei por cima de vocês, e não haverá entre vocês praga para destruição quando eu ferir a terra do Egito.
pt.B: O sangue marcará as casas onde vocês estiverem; será um sinal para vocês. Quando eu vir o sangue, passarei por cima de vocês, e a praga destruidora não cairá sobre vocês quando eu ferir a terra do Egito.
pt.R: O sangue nas casas de vocês vai ser um sinal para vocês. Eu vou ver o sangue e vou passar por cima de vocês. A praga mortal não vai atingir vocês quando eu ferir o Egito.

am.L: ደሙም ባላችሁባቸው ቤቶች ላይ ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል፤ ደሙንም አይቼ አልፋችኋለሁ፤ የግብፅን ምድር በመታሁ ጊዜ ለጥፋት የሚሆን መቅሠፍት በእናንተ ላይ አይሆንም።
am.B: ደሙ ባላችሁባቸው ቤቶች ላይ ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል። ደሙን ሳይ አልፋችኋለሁ፤ የግብፅን ምድር ስመታ የሚያጠፋው መቅሠፍት በእናንተ ላይ አይወርድም።
am.R: በቤቶቻችሁ ላይ ያለው ደም ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል። ደሙን አይቼ አልፋችኋለሁ። ግብፅን ስመታ ገዳዩ መቅሠፍት አይነካችሁም።

hi.L: और वह लहू तुम्हारे लिए उन घरों पर, जहाँ तुम [हो], एक चिह्न होगा; और मैं लहू को देखूँगा और तुम्हारे ऊपर से लाँघ जाऊँगा, और जब मैं मिस्र देश को मारूँगा, तब कोई विपत्ति नाश के लिए तुम पर न पड़ेगी।
hi.B: जिन घरों में तुम रहते हो, उन पर लगा लहू तुम्हारे लिए एक चिह्न होगा। मैं लहू को देखूँगा और तुम्हें लाँघकर आगे निकल जाऊँगा, और जब मैं मिस्र देश को मारूँगा, तब नाश करनेवाली विपत्ति तुम पर नहीं पड़ेगी।
hi.R: तुम्हारे घरों पर लगा लहू तुम्हारे लिए एक चिह्न होगा। मैं लहू को देखूँगा और तुम्हें छोड़कर आगे निकल जाऊँगा। जब मैं मिस्र पर वार करूँगा, तब वह जानलेवा विपत्ति तुम्हें छुएगी भी नहीं।

ru.L: И будет кровь у вас знамением на домах, где вы [находитесь]; и увижу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} кровь, и пройду мимо вас, и не будет на вас язвы на погибель, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду поражать землю Египта.
ru.B: Кровь отметит дома, в которых вы находитесь; она будет для вас знаком. Я увижу кровь и пройду мимо вас, и губительная язва не коснётся вас, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поражу землю Египта.
ru.R: Кровь на ваших домах будет для вас знаком. Я увижу кровь и пройду мимо вас. Смертельный удар не коснётся вас, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поражу Египет.

uk.L: І буде кров вам знаком на домах, де ви [є]; і побачу я кров, і мину вас, і не буде на вас кари на знищення, коли я вражатиму землю Єгипту.
uk.B: Кров на домах, де ви перебуваєте, буде вам знаком. Я побачу кров і мину вас, і нищівна кара не впаде на вас, коли я вражатиму єгипетську землю.
uk.R: Кров на ваших домах буде для вас знаком. Я побачу кров і мину вас. Смертельна кара не торкнеться вас, коли я вражатиму Єгипет.

decisions.choice: pass over: go past and spare
decisions.reason: The verb is the root of "Passover" (verse 11). Here and in verses 23 and 27 it most likely means to pass by a house and spare it. It may instead mean to stand over a house to protect it: Isaiah 31:5 uses it of Yahweh guarding Jerusalem like birds hovering over their young. Verse 23, where Yahweh passes over the door and keeps the destroyer out, fits either sense.

decisions.choice: a sign for you: a mark that assures Israel
decisions.reason: The blood is a sign "for you". God sees it, but it is given for Israel's sake, as a pledge that they will be spared.

decisions.choice: a plague for destruction: a deadly blow
decisions.reason: "Destruction" is the same word that names "the destroyer" in verse 23.

decisions.choice: deadly
decisions.reason: Readable says "deadly" for "for destruction": the plague is the death of the firstborn.

decisions.choice: "pasaré de largo" for pasach, here and in verses 23 and 27
decisions.reason: "Pasar de largo" is to go past without stopping, the most likely sense (m1). "Pasar por encima de alguien" would also suggest overriding or ignoring a person in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "je passerai par-dessus vous" for pasach, here and in verses 23 and 27
decisions.reason: "Passer par-dessus" keeps the link with "la Pâque" and leaves open both senses the meaning decision gives: going past a house to spare it, or standing over it to protect it.

decisions.choice: "vượt qua" for "pass over"
decisions.reason: The verb gives the feast its name (verse 11), and "vượt qua" keeps the two together as the Vietnamese name "Lễ Vượt Qua" does; the sense of sparing is in the meaning decision's footnote.

decisions.choice: passar por cima
decisions.reason: For the whole book (12:13, 23, 27): "passar por cima" keeps both readings the meaning note allows (m1), passing by a house to spare it, or standing over it to guard it, and is the image behind the name of the feast. "Poupar" would choose one sense and lose the picture.

decisions.choice: "አልፋችኋለሁ" for "I will pass over you"
